title: ETIA
subtitle: Causal AI for Data-Driven Insights and Optimal Decision Making
description: Development of ETIA, an automated causal discovery software platform embedded within a Causal AI Agent. Given a user's data, ETIA automatically discovers, explains and visualizes the plausible causal relationships, optimizes decisions and performs root-cause analysis, and can converse with the user in natural language.

title: ML4Microbiome
subtitle: Machine Learning for Human Microbiome Studies
description: A COST Action network focusing on the application of machine learning methods to human microbiome research, covering feature selection, biomarker identification, disease prediction, and treatment.

title: Cancer-Biomarkers in HUNT
subtitle: Early Detection of Lung Cancer and Mesothelioma
description: An international discovery study seeking the earliest molecular signals of lung cancer and mesothelioma in blood serum. The consortium brings together five universities in five countries, aiming to develop a blood test for screening smokers and people exposed to asbestos.

title: CAUSALPATH
subtitle: ERC Consolidator Grant — Next Generation Causal Analysis
description: Advancing causal discovery theory, methods, and tools for robust analysis of real-world data. The project studies how to infer quantitative models of biological pathways from cytometry, other omics data, and prior knowledge, with a focus on human T-cell differentiation.

title: BioDataome
subtitle: Uniform Preprocessing of Public Genomic Datasets
description: Creation of a large database of uniformly preprocessed and disease-annotated genomic and epigenomic data. Currently includes 7,345 datasets spanning 847 diseases, enabling large-scale meta-analysis.

title: DIADEx
subtitle: Predictive Explanation of Data Anomalies
description: Research and development of methods for predictive explanation of data anomalies, resulting in a best paper award at BDA 2021. Produced the DIADEx software tool.

title: T2DM Liquid Biopsy Biosignatures
subtitle: Machine learning for Type 2 Diabetes diagnosis
description: Application of AutoML to identify circulating cell-free DNA methylation signatures for accurate diagnosis and monitoring of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, achieving AUC of 0.927.

title: EPILOGEAS
subtitle: Causal-Based Variable Selection for Omics Data
funder: ARISTEIA II / European Social Fund & National Resources
description: Research on causal-based variable selection for omics data at the Institute of Computer Science, FORTH. Supported through ARISTEIA II under the Education and Lifelong Learning programme, with co-financing from the European Social Fund and national resources.

title: InnovCrete
subtitle: Multidisciplinary Structural Biology Research in Crete
description: Strengthening the capacity for multidisciplinary research driven by structural biology in Crete. Coordinated by FORTH, the project supports research excellence and innovation.

title: IdeaGarden
subtitle: An Interactive Learning Environment for Creativity
description: Developing an interactive learning environment that supports creative problem solving. The project explores visual information mash-ups and collaborative tools for creative work and learning.

title: CoRLAB
subtitle: Modeling and Analysis of Spectrum Markets
description: Developing models and simulation tools to study wireless access and spectrum markets. The research examines network services and user experience from the perspectives of providers, customers, and regulators.

title: THALIS 20332
subtitle: Collaborative Research Project
description: A research project in which members of the mens X machina group participated.

title: REACTION
subtitle: Remote Diabetes Management and Therapy
description: Developing an integrated platform for diabetes monitoring, management, and therapy across healthcare settings. The project combines glucose monitoring, clinical decision support, and tools for patient self-management.
